quarterly_data.signal: Capacity measures in FY ended March 2026: mass-producing optical transceiver components (MT fiber arrays) in a clean room at Seikoh Xunjie OFC (Hangzhou, established December 2024) and increased fiber array production at Seikoh Xunjie OFC (Hebi, established January 2026); scaled optical connector polishing machine capacity about threefold at the Japan headquarters over one year; Data Pixel increased staff 50%; increased Intelli-Cross PRO data-center connector output with in-house automated assembly equipment; production at Seikoh Giken (Thailand) launched from June 2025 and the plant passed factory audits by major customers.
